mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, user_id, merchant_id, status, total_amount, created_at, version) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{totalAmount, typeHandler=com.example.tradesystem.user.infrastructure.mapper.MoneyTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{version})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
